attchmntText: Consolidated Finvest & Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Prakash MataiRadhey Shyam as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Consolidated Finvest & Holdings Limited has intimated the resignation of Independent Directors Mr. Radhey Shyam, DIN 00649458, and Mr. Prakash Matai, DIN 07906108. The resignations are effective from the close of business hours on 12th November, 2026. The directors cited preoccupation with other professional and personal commitments as the reason for their departure. The company has submitted the resignation letters and required details under SEBI Listing Regulations to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited.

attchmntText: Consolidated Finvest & Holdings Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Consolidated Finvest & Holdings Limited announced the outcome of its Board of Directors meeting held on 12th November 2026. The Board approved the Standalone Unaudited Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended on 30th September 2026. The Limited Review Report from the Statutory Auditor for the same period was also approved. The meeting commenced at 5:15 pm and concluded at 6:30 pm. The intimation is available on the company website at http://www.consofinvest.com and on the National Stock Exchange website at www.nseindia.com.

attchmntText: Consolidated Finvest & Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 10, 2026.
voiceSummary: Consolidated Finvest & Holdings Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 10th November, 2026. The Board approved the appointment of Mr. Devendra Singh Rawat, DIN 09696674, as an Additional Director in the category of Non-Executive Independent Director. His term is for five consecutive years, from 10th November, 2026 to 09th November, 2031. The Board also approved the appointment of Mr. Suresh Chander Sharma, DIN 00006394, as an Additional Director in the same category. His term is for three consecutive years, from 10th November, 2026 to 09th November, 2029. Both appointments are subject to the approval of the members of the Company. Neither director is related to any existing director and both satisfy independence criteria.

attchmntText: Consolidated Finvest & Holdings Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  Postal Ballot. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
